item.text:
**Verdict:** mixed, leaning negative. Tinubu did make some public ethics signals in 2024, but the stronger and better-supported pattern is selective truth-telling, nepotism risk, opaque patronage channels, and punishment of scrutiny.

| Direction | Title | Publisher | Date | Claim-level summary | QIDs | URL |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| + | President Tinubu signs 2024 of Renewed Hope, directs MDAs to provide monthly performance reports | State House | 2024-01-01 | Tinubu signed the budget while emphasizing value for money, transparency, and accountability, which is a baseline ethical signal rather than proof of outcomes. | 7B.10, 7B.4, 7B.8 | https://statehouse.gov.ng/president-tinubu-signs-2024-of-renewed-hope-directs-mdas-to-provide-monthly-performance-reports/ |
| + | With good governance and commitment we must overcome old subsidy beneficiaries, President Tinubu | State House | 2024-03-15 | He said the treasury must not be abused and tied subsidy reform to targeted relief, student loans, and consumer credit using NIN data, which is a pro-public-interest framing. | 7B.10, 7B.9, 7B.4 | https://statehouse.gov.ng/with-good-governance-and-commitment-we-must-overcomee-old-subsidy-benificiaries-president-tinubu/ |
| + | President Tinubu establishes comprehensive economic coordination and planning system for Nigeria | State House | 2024-03-27 | Tinubu put the finance minister, CBN governor, economists, and private-sector figures at the center of emergency macro coordination, which supports an ethics-of-process reading rather than pure patronage. | 7B.10, 7B.5, 7B.4 | https://statehouse.gov.ng/president-tinubu-establishes-comprehensive-economic-coordination-and-planning-system-for-nigeria/ |
| + | President Tinubu directs reorganisation of the Bureau of Public Procurement | State House | 2024-06-15 | He ordered BPP reorganization for greater efficiency and transparency, a concrete anti-rent-seeking move. | 7B.10, 7B.9, 7B.4 | https://statehouse.gov.ng/president-tinubu-directs-reorganisation-of-the-bureau-of-public-procurement/ |
| + | President Tinubu: Public institutions are public trust, not personal enterprise | State House | 2024-07-06 | Tinubu publicly framed public institutions as a trust and called for merit and accountability, which is strong ethics rhetoric. | 7B.10, 7B.9, 7B.8 | https://statehouse.gov.ng/president-tinubu-live-up-to-your-expectation-as-public-trust-for-accountability/ |
| + | I have no cabal or sponsors to compensate | State House | 2024-07-26 | Tinubu denied owing a cabal or sponsors, directly rebutting a transactional-politics narrative, though this is self-assertion rather than independent proof. | 7B.10, 7B.9, 7B.8 | https://statehouse.gov.ng/president-tinubu-i-have-no-cabal-or-sponsors-to-compensate/ |
| + | Nigeria restarts cash transfers to cushion hardship caused by reforms | Reuters via MarketScreener | 2024-02-26 | The government resumed direct cash transfers to 12 million vulnerable households, which looks like broad social protection rather than a loyalty reward scheme. | 7B.10, 7B.9, 7B.4 | https://www.marketscreener.com/news/latest/Nigeria-restarts-cash-transfers-to-cushion-hardship-caused-by-reforms-46031196/ |

This is the clearest self-dealing / conflict-of-interest signal in the 2024 record. | 7B.10, 7B.9 | https://businessday.ng/news/article/tinubu-under-fire-for-appointing-son-in-law-head-of-housing-agency/ |

| - | Fact-checking president Tinubu's claims about Nigeria's economic successes in his Independence Day speech | Africa Check | 2024-08-08 | Africa Check found Tinubu’s graphic mixed, including understated reserves and an incorrect/unproven ways-and-means claim, which suggests official messaging inflated the reform story. | 7B.10, 7B.8 | https://africacheck.org/fact-checks/reports/fact-checking-president-tinubus-claims-about-nigerias-economic-successes-his |

| - | Nigeria charges protesters with treason and inciting military | Reuters via ThePrint | 2024-09-02 | Prosecutors framed protesters as destabilizers and mutineers, using criminal law to intensify pressure on dissent rather than model restraint and confidence. | 7B.10, 7B.7, 7B.6 | https://theprint.in/world/nigeria-charges-protesters-with-treason-inciting-military/2249248/ |
| - | Nigeria police used excessive force to violently quash EndBadGovernance protests | Amnesty International | 2024-11-28 | Amnesty reported killings, mass detentions, and torture in the crackdown, with authorities denying wrongdoing, which is strong negative evidence for ethical public conduct. | 7B.10, 7B.7, 7B.6 | https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/11/nigeria-police-used-excessive-force-to-violently-quash-endbadgovernance-protests/ |
| - | FG spent N63.6bn on military equipment in seven months - report | Punch | 2024-08-17 | Large, weakly disclosed military-equipment spending raises transparency and diversion concerns, which is bad evidence for disciplined and ethical public finance. | 7B.10, 7B.4, 7B.9 | https://punchng.com/fg-spent-n63-6bn-on-military-equipment-in-seven-months-report/ |
| - | FG spent N14.77bn on presidential jets in 11 months - State House report | Punch | 2024-06-23 | High-cost presidential fleet maintenance is negative evidence for frugal, public-spirited office use and raises privilege/opacity concerns. | 7B.10, 7B.4 | https://punchng.com/fg-spent-n14-77bn-on-presidential-jets-in-11-months-state-house-report/ |

**Search gap**
- I did not find strong public evidence of a voluntary asset-declaration release, campaign-finance disclosure, or any formal self-policing ethics mechanism that would independently demonstrate consistent moral leadership.
- The positive items are mostly rhetoric or reactive correction, while the negative items are more concrete: nepotistic appointment, misleading macro claims, patronage-prone distribution channels, press intimidation, and violent repression of dissent.
- One important counterweight is that Tinubu sometimes did use formal administrative channels against alleged abuse, but those cases were late and reactive rather than a standing ethical norm.
